title: Benchmarks for Indian Legal NLP: A Survey
reasoning: The paper is a technical survey proposing Natural Language Processing (NLP) benchmarks for the Indian legal domain. It focuses on tasks like information extraction, summarization, and case similarity. While law and ethics are related fields, this paper does not contain any component for evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks; its focus is on the performance of NLP models on legal text processing tasks.
